author: Mark Atwood
text: Self-flagging as opinion per /review-rusty calibration rule. The 'as u64' cast is correct on every Rust-supported target today; the 128-bit-host concern is purely hypothetical. clippy::cast_possible_truncation is a pedantic-level lint with widely-accepted exceptions for transport-size-cap arithmetic. /do-beads pass should close as wontfix unless the workspace adopts clippy::pedantic as a workspace-wide policy (which it does not today).
